subject: general
question: Which among the following acids is found in Mustard oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Erucic Acid.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mustard oil **contains **Erucic Acid,** which is a **monounsaturated omega-9 fatty acid.**
 
• Erucic Acid is also found in rapeseed
